description: This file defines the FollowersController, a REST API controller in an ASP.NET Core application that handles follow and unfollow actions for user profiles. It uses MediatR for sending commands to the application layer and applies authorization schemes.

classes.name: FollowersController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing follow/unfollow actions on user profiles via HTTP endpoints.

methods.name: Follow
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to follow a user by username, sending a command via mediator.

methods.name: Unfollow
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to unfollow a user by username, sending a command via mediator.
